title: A swirling galaxy
displayModel: The picture lies as one flat image on the midplane of the disc the photograph uses, tilted 24°. Nothing in it has depth: no thickness of M83's molecular gas is drawn.
coverage: The picture's own frame, 12.09 × 11.99 arcmin; its light ends 7.8 kpc from the centre in the disc's plane, inside the frame.

acquisition.operation: Download the publisher Large JPEG; no crop or resample.
